title: Good product, but wouldn’t work for us...
text: Good product, but wouldn’t work for us.... This was another attempt to cover skylights which were letting in too much sun - and it didn’t work well for skylights.  Since we have small pane windows, it wasn’t going to work on our windows either!  Nice try - and a good product - we just expected too much!

product_metadata.title: HIDBEA Total Blackout Window Film Room Darkening Static Cling Removable Anti-UV Glass Tint 100% Light Blocking for 24h Home Privacy, Day Sleep and Security, 35.4 inches x 32.8 feet, Matte Black
features: TOTAL BLOCKING & PRIVACY PROTECTION: This privacy window film can make your room as dark as night during the day, creating a comfortable 24-hour sleep environment for shift workers and babies.

HEAT CONTROL: HIDBEA black window film provide heat insulation in summer and heat preservation in winter. It also effectively protect your skin and furniture from harmful UV rays exposure and extend your furniture service life.
NON ADHESIVE & REUSABLE: With non adhesive and static cling design, this static cling tinting can be easily removed without sticky residue, and can be reused as many times as you need.

WIDE APPLICABLE SCOPE: This light blocking film provide the highest level of privacy. It can effectively block the outside view and provide you with a private space. In other words, it's very suitable for smooth and flat windows in nurseries, meeting rooms, offices, bedrooms, and bathrooms. (NOTE: Suitable for single pane glass)

USER FRIENDLY INSTALLATION: Due to its unique staic cling design, no glue is required during the installation process. You just need to spray enough water on both the smooth side of the film and the window to effectively attach to the film.

RELIABLE CUSTOMER SERVICE: If you're unsatisfied with our product for any reason, please feel free to message us. We want to provide you with the best removable blackout window film, as well as customer service that you can trust.
description: HIDBEA blackout film offers full privacy and blocks any undesirable views. It’s 100% light proof and Non-Adhesive. Rejects infrared heat from the sun, anti-glare, as well as block out UV rays which damage furnishings over time. Eliminates hot spots, which allows for a more consistent temperature in all areas of your business. 1. Cut the pieces of film so they measure about 2-3cm larger than the window panes being covered. 2. Peel off the transparent back side of the film. 3. Generously spray enough water/dish washing liquid mix with water onto the window surface. The water makes it easier to position the film and helps hold it on the window. 4. Apply from top to bottom, for large size window, two people is recommended. 5. Use squeegee to push the bubbles out. We have installation kit for sale. 6. Trim the extra film. Tips: 1. Newspaper or waste paper is ideal to remove tiny spots on window surface, these spots will create bubbles on your finishing. 2. Generously spray dish washing liquid water onto the exposed back side of the film makes the separation easier. 3. Be sure the window is dripping wet, if it becomes dry, rewet it completely before applying film. 4. Apply in early morning or late evening when the glass is cooler to avoid Bubbles/spots. 5. Please make sure to leave 2mm (0. 08 inches) gap between the film and the window frame since there are sealant glue or painting residue left on the corner. When heat expands, the film will easily fell off.
